gallery.title: Premium Flat-Bottom Side Gusset Coffee Bags
gallery.desc: Flat-bottom side gusset coffee bags with triple-sealed gussets for stable standing and full-panel branding. Multi-layer kraft or matte PET/AL/PE with a one-way degassing valve and high-barrier liner to lock in aroma. Custom printing, lamination and embossing available.
gallery.content:
**Built to Protect. Designed to Sell.**

Give your coffee the packaging it deserves. Our flat-bottom side gusset bags pair strong multi-layer barriers with a clean, premium look — keeping whole bean and ground coffee fresh while making your brand stand out on shelf.

**Smart Structure**

Triple-sealed side gussets expand capacity and give the bag a stable, upright base. The flat bottom sits firmly on any shelf, and the front, back and gusset panels give you generous space for your logo and artwork.

**Freshness You Can Trust**

Choose natural kraft paper (Kraft/PET/PE) or matte-finish PET/AL/PE. A one-way degassing valve releases CO₂ without letting oxygen in, while the heat-sealable inner liner blocks oxygen, moisture, UV light and odors — locking in aroma from roastery to cup.

**Made Yours**

Finish it your way: eco-friendly printing, matte or gloss lamination, or embossing for a premium tactile feel. Low MOQ and fast sampling available — send us your artwork and we will help with the dieline.

Flat-bottom gusset coffee bags with a tin tie, made to your exact requirements — size, material, printing, thickness and packing details are all tailored to your needs. Every bag can be finished with a one-way degassing valve, a resealable tin tie or an easy-tear notch.

**Why Choose These Bags**

**One-Way Degassing Valve**
The one-way valve lets CO₂ escape from freshly roasted beans while keeping outside air out, so roasters can pack coffee right away without the risk of bursting.

**Resealable Tin Tie**
The sticky tin strips are easy to open and close, and the adhesive is strong enough to keep beans fresh between uses — saving time and trouble.

**Easy-Tear Notch**
A precise tear notch makes the bag easy to open by hand. The film stays strong in transit, and the top can be re-sealed with a sealing machine after opening.

**VMPET Barrier**
The metallised PET layer resists moisture and effectively prevents liquid penetration, protecting flavour and aroma.

The hanging ears fit over most cup sizes. Just open the sachet, hook it on, pour hot water and let it drip. No kettle setup, no filter paper, no mess — a single-serve solution that fits modern coffee habits.

**Food-Contact Safe & Moisture Proof**
Made from a food-contact-grade kraft / foil composite with a moisture-proof barrier. The material protects the ground coffee from humidity and keeps the aroma in until the bag is opened. Heat-sealed closure keeps each sachet secure in transit.

**Thick, Consistent Build**
Each bag measures 10×12.5 cm with an approx. 0.26 mm (26-silk) double-layer structure. The sturdy film holds its shape during filling and shipping, with a tight size tolerance of ±0.01 mm for clean, consistent branding.

**15+ Colours and Finishes**
Choose UV-printed colours — white, black, pink, red, kraft, gold, light blue, dark blue, brown and Hermes orange — or go with an unprinted kraft version for your own label. A no-lamination white kraft option is available too.

**Make It Yours**
Add your logo with custom printing, hot stamping, UV varnish or a glossy finish. Whether you are a roaster launching a single-origin drip line or a brand building a private-label range, we help you finish the artwork.

gallery.content:
**Custom Printed Flat-Bottom Kraft Foil Coffee Bags with Zipper & Valve**

A shelf-ready bag built for fresh coffee. The flat base keeps it upright, the kraft-and-foil structure protects the beans, and the zipper plus one-way valve keep them fresh from the roastery to the last cup. Printed in your own design, in the colours your brand needs.

**Flat Bottom, Five Printable Faces**
The flat-bottom construction gives the pouch a stable base that stands firmly on shelf. Front, back, two gussets and the base give you five faces for your logo, origin story and brewing instructions.

**MOPP / Kraft / VMPET / PE Structure**
A food-grade multi-layer laminate combining natural kraft paper with a metallised barrier layer. It resists moisture, oxygen and light — the three things that shorten coffee's shelf life. Choose white kraft or brown kraft, or send us your own artwork for full-colour gravure printing.

**Zipper + One-Way Valve**
The zipper top lets customers reseal the bag after opening. The one-way degassing valve releases CO₂ from freshly roasted beans while keeping outside air out — no swollen bags and no oxidised coffee.

**Six Ready Sizes, Two Thicknesses**
Stock square sizes and vertical sizes are available, plus 20×30 cm and 25×35 cm options. Thicknesses of 0.1 mm and 0.12 mm are available, and custom sizes are accepted for exact fit.

**Built Around Your Brand**
Custom colours, custom logo and gravure printing. New orders take 15–25 days and repeat orders 15–20 days. We ship by air, sea, rail or express (DHL, UPS, TNT, FedEx) to suit your schedule and budget.
